smcCodes.description: VA Special Monthly Compensation (SMC) codes and rates

rates.name: Aid and Attendance - Basic
requirements: Need assistance in performing activities of daily living

rates.name: Aid and Attendance - Improved
requirements: More severe aid and attendance requirements

rates.name: Aid and Attendance - Highest
requirements: Most severe aid and attendance requirements

rates.name: Housebound - Basic
requirements: Unable to leave home except with assistance

rates.name: Loss of Use of One Extremity
requirements: Loss of use of one arm or leg

rates.name: Loss of Use of One Extremity (Enhanced)
requirements: Loss of use plus other qualifying conditions

rates.name: Loss of Both Hands and Feet, or Blindness
requirements: Bilateral extremity loss or total blindness with bilateral extremity loss

smcCodes.note: Rates are effective as of date shown. These rates are updated annually/monthly based on COLA adjustments.
